scientific_mode: Simultaneous finite-amplitude coframe and shape solves on the fixed R757 initial metric. Each positive phase is an actual global position field. The material cylinder follows the selected prescribed track. The shape solve releases both rolls, both caps and the common rim jets on both sides. The fourth fully solved starting design uses the constant 2+2 curvature law. Three bounded-ratio starts and three R763/R761 reference starts have separate winning continuations.

Complete two-side Kronecker least squares over all independent phase-node physical fields, every positive knot and midpoint jointly. Refresh actual polar, covariant and chord merits after each physical trial. Reweight the worst complete material sites in a second block. Coarse bounded-ratio candidates and original R763/R761 candidates each generate their own fixed-g 4/8/16 refinements. The constant 2+2 case is globally evaluated as a mathematically excluded thickness control, never advanced as the bounded-curvature candidate.
